report_name: France Confirms Breach of 678,000 Taxpayer Records by Hacker 'ZeroBytes'

threat_actors.name: ZeroBytes
threat_actors.description: Threat actor who claimed responsibility for the DGFiP data breach, gaining access via stolen credentials and selling the data on a criminal forum in August 2026.
threat_actors.goals: Financial gain from selling stolen taxpayer data.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attacker obtained and used legitimate credentials for an employee and an authorized third party to gain initial access to the internal network.

attack_patterns.name: External Remote Services
attack_patterns.description: The attacker used stolen credentials to connect to an internal company VPN, bypassing perimeter defenses and appearing as a legitimate user.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: Once on the internal network, the attacker accessed and used an internal search application to query and retrieve sensitive data from taxpayer databases.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The attacker systematically exfiltrated the collected taxpayer data over the encrypted VPN tunnel, blending the malicious traffic with normal network activity.

identities.name: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP)
identities.description: The French tax authority that suffered a major data breach affecting 678,000 taxpayers after an attacker compromised an internal VPN and search tool.

identities.name: French Taxpayers
identities.description: A group of 678,000 individuals and professionals in France whose personal and financial data was exfiltrated from the DGFiP and offered for sale by the threat actor ZeroBytes.

infrastructure.name: Criminal Forum
infrastructure.description: The online criminal forum where the threat actor ZeroBytes advertised and offered the stolen DGFiP taxpayer data for sale on August 12, 2026.

indicators.name: Suspicious Internal Data Query Tool Usage
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Internal Data Query Tool Usage
id: 2b8c1f9e-a5d4-4e3f-8b1a-9c7d6e5f4a3b
status: experimental
description: Detects the potential use of an internal data query tool with an export flag, which could indicate data collection activity as seen in the DGFiP breach.
references:
  - https://cybernews.com/news/france-confirms-taxpayer-data-stolen/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-16
tags:
  - attack.t1213
  - attack.collection
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
level: medium
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\search_tool.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '--export'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the potential use of an internal data query tool with an export flag, based on hunting hints provided in the analysis of the DGFiP breach.
